nodes.name: deploy-aws-ecs
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the Angular app, packages it into a Docker image, pushes to ECR, and deploys to AWS ECS via a task definition update.

nodes.name: deploy-aws-s3-cloudfront
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the Angular app and deploys the static build artifacts to an S3 bucket, then invalidates the CloudFront distribution cache.

nodes.name: deploy-gh-pages
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the Angular app with the GitHub Pages base href and publishes the dist output to the gh-pages branch.

nodes.name: test-ci
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs the Angular unit tests with ChromeHeadless on every push or pull request to the main branch.
